pages.text: You once suspected that Brainiacs were bio-augmented humans created by the ancient civilization responsible for the environment here. After the Toxic Caves became what they are today, these long-uncontrolled augmented beings began to mutate under the effects of radiation. As a necromancy genius, you have discovered how to create a Brainiac.

Equipping Necro Cape grants your Brainiac passive healing, and Rotten Flesh can also be fed to heal it. If a Brainiac loses its Waste Drum, you can hand it a new one by right-clicking it while holding a Waste Drum.
